name: The daily westbound: in from Durango, the depot, the Ore Works, and on through the tunnel
_doc: Valley G3 (#716; docs/briefs/valley-plan.md §4): the train's day on the valley's main line (config/valley.json railway.route), stops by the route's mark names, the engine's front on each mark. `start_hour` is the game clock's hour it leaves east_start (ValleyRailway starts it as the clock passes it each day, and at load puts it where the timetable has it by the clock); every time after that is real seconds of the run, the arrive and depart times worked out from the line (TrainTimetable.fill: the run driven once at planned_kmh, plus padding). The game's day is 45 minutes (config/day_cycle.tres), so a game hour is 112.5 s: the run takes about fifteen game hours (08:00 to about 23:00), the depot about 12:30. One train a day, westbound (the eastbound back needs the consist turned: the engine first the other way). All PROPOSED.
